sources.title: Shreshth Saini
sources.snippet: LumaGuide is a training-free framework for distribution shaping in diffusion models. Instead of modifying model parameters, it steers the sampling process to match target feature distributions via differentiable energy-based guidance, instantiated for HDR generation by controlling luminance distributions in perceptually uniform PQ space.
